plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Status line: git branch + worktree + ANSI colors, context/effort segments.

plugins.name: ctx-tokens
plugins.description: Read current context token usage from the live session transcript.

plugins.name: ctx-limit
plugins.description: Per-session context-size limit: past the threshold a hook blocks the prompt, warns, or runs a command. Pairs with handoff. Run /ctx-limit.

plugins.name: junk-drawer
plugins.description: Cheatsheet of the whole marketplace: every plugin with its version, description, and commands + params. Run /junk-drawer.

plugins.name: junkd
plugins.description: Handoff, orch and tldr in one plugin, every command /junkd:<name>: /junkd:handoff and /junkd:handon save and resume a session, /junkd:ahandoff hands off at a context threshold; /junkd:orch runs the orchestration loop (/junkd:orch-init first) with a main-loop guard on Fable; /junkd:tldr summarizes or keeps replies terse. /junkd opens the junkd, handoff and orch tabs: the marketplace's plugins, every setting group and the commands. The hooks module exports $.junkd for other mods.
